report.summary: tests/test_structcore_parallel.py: Structural scan tests for parallel per-file pass, persistent cache, and determinism of the index build.
risks: CLAIMS|tests/test_structcore_parallel.py|The bar for this work is DETERMINISM, not speed: the parallel and cached paths must produce byte-identical indexes to the serial one.
CLAIMS|tests/test_structcore_parallel.py|Order preservation is load-bearing (the clone passes consume it positionally).
